sounds.name: startup
sounds.description: Boot chime: rising pad swell under a glassy bell arpeggio.

sounds.name: shutdown
sounds.description: Goodbye: descending bell phrase settling onto a soft low pad.

sounds.name: logon
sounds.description: Short welcome swell for signing in.

sounds.name: ding
sounds.description: Default beep: a single rounded bell.

sounds.name: critical_stop
sounds.description: Error dialog: low dissonant thump with a bell cluster.

sounds.name: menu_click
sounds.description: Start menu / button click: tight glassy tick.

sounds.name: recycle
sounds.description: Empty Recycle Bin: crumple of short noise bursts.

sounds.name: chat_in
sounds.description: ForgeChat message received: two quick soft bells.

sounds.name: buddy_in
sounds.description: Buddy signed on: creaky door swing up into a chime.

sounds.name: buddy_out
sounds.description: Buddy signed off: chime falling into a door thud.

sounds.name: lobby_ready
sounds.description: Game lobby: all players ready fanfare.

sounds.name: call_ring
sounds.description: ForgeChat incoming video call ring (one cycle).
